about: ESCHATON public prediction registry. Append-only, hash-chained; verify with js/registry.js. Do not edit by hand.

models.persistence: base rate given whether the theme was above its median in the state month
models.convergence: persistence, further split by whether 3+ themes ran high at once in the state month

body.methodInvalidation: After 12 resolved months: if the persistence model's mean Brier score is not below the base-rate model's, the momentum claim is refuted; if the convergence model does not beat persistence, the convergence signal adds no predictive value.

forecasts.question: Will "Fire & explosions" be above its usual level in 2026-12?
forecasts.criteria: Resolves YES if more than 8.79% of the news items in Wikipedia's Current events portal for 2026-12 touch the theme "Fire & explosions" (the theme's median monthly share over 2016-01 to 2026-10), as measured by ESCHATON's lexicon. Otherwise NO.
forecasts.invalidation: Wrong if the 2026-12 share ends at or below 8.79%.

forecasts.question: Will 3 or more themes run unusually high at once in 2026-12?
forecasts.criteria: Resolves YES if, in 2026-12, at least 3 themes each exceed their own 90th-percentile monthly share (training months) while appearing in 3+ items. Otherwise NO.
forecasts.invalidation: Wrong if fewer than 3 themes run high in 2026-12.
